Powering the future – We're committed to a lower carbon energy future powered by renewable sources, such as wind farms. Discover ESB Networks Our mission & Values Our strategy Innovation at ESB Networks Our network Environment & Sustainability Our people Data and digital Key facts Distribution Network 184,000 km 184,000 km is the total length of overhead lines and underground cables run by ESB Networks for distribution. Distribution system 43,471 We connected around 43,471 new customers (homes & businesses) in 2025, to make a total of roughly 2.5 million customers connected. Operating, Installing, Maintaining 2 million Over 2 m smart meters have been installed in homes, farms and businesses across Ireland, providing customers with access to more detailed information about their electricity usage. We know that an open and ongoing dialogue is essential Stakeholder & Public engagement At ESB Networks, we've been connecting customers to Ireland's power network for years. We've also been making new connections, building a network that's stronger than ever so we can all be kinder to the planet.
